full_judgment: 18. Scrutinizing the connected papers on records it further appears that both the courts below considering the C.S. khatians as well as the fact of gifting ¼ land of the Khatian by Abbas vide Ext-"Cha" and of ¼  land of the Khatian in the name of Abdul being sold in auction, concurrently held that Osman, Abbas, Abdul and Sadhu were the owners of the suit land and the daughters of Sheikh Mohar had no subsisting interest in the said land. Therefore, no title would be conferred upon the defendants, those who purchased of land from the daughters of Sheikh Mohar. In this context the provisions of sections 143, 144 and 144A of the state Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 are relevant and the decision reported in 61 DLR 18 (Para-30) as referred from the side of the opposite-parties can be relied on.
